0022600003.text: The Thunder open their 2026-27 season on the road against the San Antonio Spurs, who also have not yet played a game this season. Oklahoma City lost the 2025-26 regular-season series 1-4 and the 2025-26 playoff series 3-4, with the most recent meeting a 111-103 loss in Oklahoma City on May 30. The Spurs are missing Jayden Quaintance, who is out after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives Oklahoma City a 45% chance to win.
